prompt: Label towns with rules: bold dark labels for towns with population above 100, small grey labels for the others.
expected: Two label looks on the map; Layer Styling > Labels shows Rule-based with two rules. Then 'undo the last operation' returns to the previous labels.

prompt: First: label towns by name. Then: add callout lines to the town labels, a red 0.4 mm line with a manhattan style, and a white mask around the label text.
expected: Needs simple labels first (a layer without labels is refused with a hint). Callout lines show once a label sits away from its point (move one with the Label toolbar); mask halo visible. Undo restores.

prompt: Show a pie chart diagram of pop and area_km2 on districts, 12 mm.
expected: A pie per district; Layer Styling > Diagrams is active. 'remove the diagram from districts' clears it. Undo works.

prompt: Make the town markers a star from the font Arial, 5 mm, orange. Then use the SVG file <path to any .svg> as the marker.
expected: Markers change to a font character, then to the SVG. A polygon layer is refused with a clear message.

prompt: Style dem as a hillshade with azimuth 315 and altitude 45. Then show contour lines every 20 with an index line every 100.
expected: Hillshade renderer, then a contour renderer, on the dem. Undo restores the previous style.

prompt: Save the symbol of the layer towns to my library as 'town-star'.
expected: Success message with the name; saving the same name again asks before overwriting.

prompt: What symbols do I have in my library?
expected: Lists 'town-star' (and any others) with tags.

prompt: Save the style of the layer roads as a symbol called road-test, then apply the saved symbol road-test to the layer roads.
expected: Asks for confirmation (symbol type must fit); after confirming the symbol changes; undo restores.

prompt: In Test Layout add an overview map in the top-right corner, 50 by 40 mm, with a red frame.
expected: An inset map appears with a red rectangle showing the main map's extent; moving the main map moves the frame.

prompt: In Test Layout add a vertical guide at 20 mm and a horizontal guide at 15 mm, and set the snapping grid to 5 mm.
expected: Guides show in the layout designer; the grid spacing is 5 mm; items snap to it.

prompt: In Test Layout set up an atlas with one page per district, named by the name field, sorted by name.
expected: Atlas panel shows the coverage layer districts and 4 pages; atlas preview steps through districts.

prompt: In Test Layout add a bar chart of pop by name for the layer towns, 120 by 80 mm. Then a pie chart, then a line chart.
expected: A chart item appears each time; check bars/pie/line show the right values (this has only been checked for existence so far - note how it LOOKS). Try with a layer tagged RESTRICTED: a warning appears.

prompt: Turn on elevation for dem, then in Test Layout add an elevation profile for dem along the line from 0.2,0.2 to 3.8,3.8.
expected: Without elevation on, the tool says so. With it on, a profile item appears; check the profile curve follows the dem along the line.

prompt: Export Test Layout to a PNG with a world file, and to a GeoPDF.
expected: PNG plus a .wld file next to it; a GeoPDF opens in a viewer (georeferenced if the viewer supports it). Overwrite asks first.

prompt: Open the point cloud <path to a .copc.laz or an ept.json> as a layer. Then try a plain .las or .laz.
expected: COPC/EPT opens and draws. A plain .las/.laz opens only if QGIS has the PDAL provider; otherwise a clear message says so. SKIP if you have no point cloud.

prompt: Add the vector tile layer https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/vectortiles/carto.streets/v1/{z}/{x}/{y}.mvt (zoom 0 to 14). Then try a local .mbtiles file.
expected: Tiles draw (example URL; use any vector tile service you can reach). http:// URLs and URLs without {z}/{x}/{y} are refused.

prompt: Add the 3D tiles tileset <URL or path of a tileset.json>.
expected: The tiled scene layer is added (it draws in 3D views; in 2D it may look empty). SKIP if you have no tileset.

prompt: Turn on elevation for dem as a surface, band 1, offset 5 m. For towns set clamping to relative with extrusion 12 m.
expected: Layer Properties > Elevation shows the settings. Asking to 'enable' a vector layer is refused (vectors have no switch). Undo restores.

prompt: Use dem as the project terrain with scale 1.5. Then set the terrain to flat with offset 0.
expected: Project Properties > Elevation shows the DEM terrain, then flat. A 3D view (View > 3D Map Views) uses it.

prompt: Filter districts to only those with pop above 1000. Then clear the filter.
expected: Only matching features draw; Layer Properties > Source > Query Builder shows the filter; clearing restores all. Text with ; or comments is refused. Undo restores.

prompt: Move the towns with pop above 100 by 0.5 degrees east, rotate them 30 degrees, scale them 1.2.
expected: Shows a preview with the exact count first; after you confirm the geometries change (rotation and scale are about each feature's centre, so single points only move). Reversible with undo_manual_edit while the layer is in edit mode.

prompt: Select the districts named A and B, then merge the selected districts into one feature.
expected: Preview with counts, then one merged feature: the first feature keeps its attributes and the others are deleted, so confirm only on a copy. Needs at least two features.

prompt: Split districts with the line LINESTRING(1 -1, 1 5).
expected: Preview, then districts crossing x=1 are split; a line that misses everything is reported.

prompt: Start editing towns, change one value by hand, then say: undo my last edit on towns.
expected: The hand edit is reversed (works only while the layer is in edit mode; for assistant operations on a layer not in edit mode the model should use undo_last_operation instead).

prompt: Redo the edit on towns.
expected: The undone edit returns.

prompt: Change the field pop on towns to text.
expected: Preview says how many values cannot be converted (they become NULL); after confirming the type changes and the field moves to the end of the table.

prompt: Start editing towns. Then save the edits. Start again and discard the changes.
expected: Toggle edit mode, save, and discard work; discard asks for confirmation.

prompt: Add the PostGIS table public.<table> from the connection <your saved connection>.
expected: Layer is added without asking for a password in chat (credentials come from the saved connection). SKIP if you have no PostGIS.

prompt: Create a virtual layer called big_towns with SQL: SELECT name, pop, geometry FROM towns WHERE pop > 10.
expected: A live virtual layer appears. A query that writes (INSERT/ATTACH) or names a file path is refused.

prompt: Load the QLR file <path>.
expected: Layers from the .qlr appear with their styles.

prompt: Save towns and districts as a QLR file at <path>.
expected: A .qlr is written; overwriting asks first; reload it with load_layer_definition.

prompt: Package towns, roads and districts into one GeoPackage at <path>.
expected: One .gpkg with the three layers and their styles. With a RESTRICTED layer a warning appears. Overwriting asks first.

prompt: Add the NetCDF file <path.nc> / mesh file <path.2dm>.
expected: Raster or mesh layer opens as the file type says (ECW/MrSID only if your QGIS has the driver). SKIP files you do not have.

prompt: Make districts fill light yellow with a grey 0.3 mm outline at 60 percent opacity.
expected: The symbol changes accordingly (check colours and opacity by eye).

prompt: Give the town labels a white halo 1 mm, size 10, bold, placed around the point.
expected: Labels get the halo and style.

prompt: For dem use cubic resampling and 70 percent opacity, and treat values below 0 as no data.
expected: Raster renders accordingly (resampling, opacity, no-data).

prompt: In Test Layout add a label 'Hello' at 10,10; a picture <path>; a rectangle; an arrow; an attribute table of towns (name, pop).
expected: Each item appears; the table shows the chosen fields. HTML frames are refused on purpose.

prompt: Move the label to 60,10, rotate it 15 degrees, then remove the arrow.
expected: Item moves/rotates; removal works; wrong ids are reported.

prompt: Set the map in Test Layout to scale 1:5000000, rotation 10, and fit it to the layer districts.
expected: Map scale/rotation/extent update.

prompt: Set the Test Layout page to A3 landscape.
expected: Page size changes.

prompt: Save Test Layout as a template at <path>.
expected: A .qpt file is written (overwrite asks).

prompt: Load the template <path> as a new layout called From Template.
expected: New layout appears with the template's items.

prompt: Put the layers towns and roads in a group called Test group, then rename the group Test group to Base data.
expected: Group renamed in the layer tree.

prompt: Zoom to the previous extent, then to the next one.
expected: Map returns to earlier extents (needs the real canvas).

prompt: Show the metadata of towns.
expected: Title, abstract, keywords, etc. shown.

prompt: Set the title of towns to 'Test towns', abstract 'Hand test', keywords test, rc44.
expected: Layer Properties > Metadata shows the values.

prompt: Turn on snapping to vertices and segments with 12 pixels tolerance and topological editing.
expected: Project > Snapping Options reflects it.

prompt: Create a relation called district_towns: parent districts.name, child towns.name.
expected: Project Properties > Relations lists it (use fields that make sense in your data).

prompt: List the relations.
expected: Shows district_towns.

prompt: Make towns time-aware using the field seen.
expected: Layer Properties > Temporal is on with seen as start field; undo restores.

prompt: Set the project time range from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.
expected: Project Properties > Temporal shows the range.

prompt: Add the text 'Check this area' at 1.5, 1.5 on the map.
expected: Annotation appears on the canvas.

prompt: Remove all annotations.
expected: Asks first, then removes them.

prompt: Create an empty polygon layer called study_area with fields name text and ha number.
expected: Empty scratch layer with those fields; with a .gpkg path it is saved there.

prompt: Add an OpenStreetMap basemap.
expected: Basemap at the bottom of the tree; asking again reuses it.

prompt: Add the WMS layer <https URL> layer <name>.
expected: Layer added; http:// URLs and localhost are refused. SKIP without a service.

prompt: Which layers in the project are broken?
expected: Lists layers with missing files (move a file first to see one).

prompt: Repair the broken layer <name> by looking in <folder>.
expected: Layer source repointed and the layer draws.

prompt: Save districts as a GeoPackage at <path> in EPSG:3857 with only name and pop.
expected: New file written; overwrite asks first; the layer is added if asked.

prompt: Select the towns where pop > 100.
expected: Matching points highlighted; a dangerous expression (file functions) is refused.

prompt: Select all districts.
expected: All selected.

prompt: Clear the selection.
expected: Selection cleared.

prompt: Select the towns with pop below 50, then delete the selected towns.
expected: Preview with count; deleted only after confirmation; undo_manual_edit reverses.

prompt: Set pop to 0 for the town named a.
expected: Preview with counts, then the value changes.

prompt: Add a text field note to towns.
expected: Field appears.

prompt: Rename the field note to remark.
expected: Field renamed.

prompt: Delete the field remark from towns.
expected: Asks first; field removed.

prompt: Add a point POINT(1 1) to towns with name z and pop 7.
expected: New feature appears.

prompt: Create a group Hand test containing towns and roads.
expected: Group in the tree with the layers.

prompt: Move districts into the group Hand test.
expected: Layer moves.

prompt: Hide the group Hand test and collapse it.
expected: Visibility/expansion change.

prompt: Zoom the map to scale 1:2000000 centred on 2,2.
expected: Map view changes (needs the canvas).

prompt: Set the project CRS to EPSG:3857.
expected: Project CRS changes.

prompt: Assign EPSG:4326 to the layer towns.
expected: Asks first (it does not reproject); CRS assigned.

prompt: Create a bookmark Test area for the extent of districts.
expected: Bookmark in the Spatial Bookmarks panel.

prompt: List my bookmarks.
expected: Shows Test area.

prompt: Go to the bookmark Test area.
expected: Map zooms there (needs the canvas).

prompt: Set the project title to rc44 hand test and a variable team = qa.
expected: Title and variable visible in Project Properties.

prompt: Measure the distance from 0,0 to 3,4 (EPSG:4326).
expected: Ellipsoidal length in metres and kilometres plus the bearing in degrees. Ask for a closed polygon of 3 points to also get area in square metres and hectares.

prompt: Is there a processing algorithm for densifying lines?
expected: Lists matching approved algorithms with their parameter names.

prompt: Calculate dem@1 > 100 as a new layer called high_ground.
expected: New raster with 0/1 values; an unsafe expression (python) is refused.

prompt: Delineate the watershed upstream of 2.0, 2.0 using dem.
expected: Basin, longest flow path and outlet layers plus area, stream length, relief figures (needs a real DEM to be meaningful).

prompt: Search the web for recent reports about flooding in Yemen and give me sources.
expected: A sourced list of results; sources are named, no invented links (network dependent).
